title: Optical Fourier Architecture for Universal Nonlinear Functions
summary: We introduce an exact algebraic architecture that evaluates an arbitrary finite Fourier series using a two-mode ($2 \times 2$) linear optical circuit, with the only tunable components being single-mode phase shifters encoding the function argument. We prove that such a circuit must exist for every Fourier series and derive an analytical method for its construction based on spectral factorisation.
